artDirection: Five progressively larger asteroid mining facilities sharing the user's reference style and viewpoint.

tiers.title: Prospecting Outpost
tiers.description: One articulated drill, a compact control module, one solar panel, and a utility docking boom.
tiers.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one finished landscape game concept-art image in a coherent five-tier asteroid mining complex set.
Input image 1 is the user's TIER-1 DESIGN, material, lighting, asteroid geometry, and viewpoint reference. Use it as a reference to generate this single requested tier. Do not create a montage or a tier comparison sheet.
Scene and rendering: photorealistic hard-surface science-fiction 3D render, isolated in nearly pure black empty space. Match the reference's rugged charcoal-brown asteroid, cratered irregular oval rock shape, chalky weathered off-white utilitarian machinery, graphite solar/radiator panels, dark mechanical joints, steel trusses, sparse warm amber work lights, fine seams and restrained grime.
Camera and composition: wide landscape approximately 16:9; elevated three-quarter view looking down at the asteroid's top and front face, matching the reference's orientation and upper-left key light. Entire asteroid and ALL extremities of machinery, panels, docking booms and any ring fully inside frame, with black margin on all sides. The subject fills about 85 percent of frame. Pull back as needed for upper tiers. Crisp clear silhouette and large structures readable at thumbnail size.
Lighting: physically based sunlight from upper left; bright readable surfaces, detailed shaded rock, restrained amber practical lamps, cinematic contrast without burying the equipment in darkness.
Engineering: all buildings and machinery securely attached to rock or structural trusses, physically plausible joints and load-bearing architecture; ore moves in enclosed conveyors. Static vacuum scene with no smoke or atmospheric haze.
Text: none. No captions, numbers, logos, interface, watermarks, borders or grid.

Tier design:
TIER 1 — PROSPECTING OUTPOST. Match the attached reference very closely: an almost entirely bare rough asteroid, a single small off-white rounded rectangular control and processing module on its upper-right shoulder, one large articulated excavator arm immediately to the left of the module with a drill head pointing down into a shallow scrape, one upright rectangular dark solar panel behind the module, one narrow docking boom extending to the right and holding a very small utility tug. Preserve the modest, sparse scale of the original equipment; the complex occupies roughly one quarter of the visible upper surface. Only this small starter facility, with generous bare rock. The drill is the focal feature.

tiers.description: Three drill arms, enclosed ore conveyors, a sorting module, expanded solar power, and paired cargo docks.

Tier design:
TIER 2 — AUTOMATED MINE. Evolve the attached starter outpost into a modest but unmistakably expanded automated mine. Keep the original compact white control module on the asteroid's upper-right shoulder and its rightward dock as the recognizable anchor. Add two more articulated mining drill arms, for three arms in total spread around one broad shallow excavation; add one adjacent ore-crushing/sorting module, short enclosed ore conveyors linking the drill bases to the sorter, a small rack of cargo containers, two dark rectangular solar wings, and a second modest cargo docking finger. A single small cargo tug gives scale. Equipment occupies roughly 40 percent of the upper surface; most of the asteroid remains bare and fully visible. Strong readable silhouette dominated by THREE articulated drill arms. No large ring, no giant tower, no deep terraced crater yet.

tiers.description: A terraced central pit, bridge gantry and core drill, with ore handling buildings and cargo storage.

Tier design:
TIER 3 — DEEP-CORE QUARRY. Evolve the attached small outpost into a substantial mining installation with one newly excavated DEEP TERRACED PIT in the asteroid's upper-left center. The dominant new silhouette is a large industrial bridge gantry spanning the open pit, carrying a heavy vertical core-drill assembly down into it. The pit must be clearly open and visible beneath the gantry. Keep the original small white control module and its rightward dock recognizable on the upper-right shoulder, surrounded by an expanded cluster of 4 compact interconnected processing buildings, cylindrical ore silos, enclosed ore conveyor runs, and a tidy cargo loading deck. Two smaller articulated drill arms remain around the pit rim. Broad dark solar/radiator banks extend from the rear of the facility. Two docking fingers, one small freighter. Equipment occupies roughly 55 percent of the upper asteroid surface; rugged lower hemisphere remains naturally rocky and intact. Strong design hierarchy: one terraced pit and one bridge gantry. No orbital ring.

Tier design:
TIER 4 — REFINERY COMPLEX. Evolve the attached modest outpost into a sprawling, clearly advanced asteroid-scale INDUSTRIAL REFINERY. Keep the rocky asteroid as the primary body and preserve the original small starter module as a tiny recognizable component on its upper-right shoulder. A broad terraced open-pit excavation dominates the left upper surface, served by two heavy bridge gantries with vertical core drills. Across the right and rear of the rock, build interconnected white refinery blocks, a prominent pair of cylindrical separation towers, sealed smelter housings showing subtle amber light through small vents, a substantial reactor block, rows of ore silos, enclosed conveyor bridges, exposed pipes, and stacked container racks. Large dark finned radiator wings project from the back. A three-berth freight terminal extends to the right, with one small cargo freighter for scale. About 70 percent of the upper surface is industrialized, but substantial rugged raw rock remains visible along the entire lower hemisphere. This is a dense coherent factory with strong large forms, not random greebles. No complete encircling orbital ring yet.

tiers.title: Asteroid Foundry
tiers.description: A complete industrial ring supports vast extraction works, foundries, radiator arrays, and heavy freighter berths.

Tier design:
TIER 5 — ASTEROID FOUNDRY. The final monumental evolution of the attached small asteroid mine: the same recognizable rough dark asteroid is now visibly EMBRACED BY ONE COMPLETE HEAVY INDUSTRIAL RING around its equator. The ring must read as a continuous elliptical structure in perspective, with open space between ring and rock and stout radial truss supports physically anchored into the asteroid. It is an industrial cargo/conveyor ring, not a smooth futuristic halo. Large white refinery and manufacturing blocks, cargo rail lines, storage yards, and four extended freighter berths are integrated into the ring. Above the asteroid, a vast open terraced extraction basin is crossed by a very large core-extraction gantry, flanked by dense but orderly processing buildings, separation towers and a central reactor housing. Broad dark radiator arrays extend outward from the ring. Keep plenty of natural rugged rock visible inside and below the ring, which frames rather than hides the asteroid. Two small docked heavy cargo freighters convey scale. The original starter module survives as a tiny module on the upper-right shoulder. A compelling clean silhouette of ROCK + INDUSTRIAL RING + HUGE EXTRACTION GANTRY. Most advanced tier, clearly much larger infrastructure than all lower tiers, grounded in the exact same weathered white engineering language. No city skyscrapers, weapons, magical effects, or ornamental space-station rings.
